prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Master Desktop Companion Commands", "Practice calling, moving, and hiding your desktop pet before completing setup.", "Practice Pet Commands"]
1: ["Creating Your Desktop Pet", "Preparing 3D pet mesh, textures, and desktop behaviors..."]
2: ["Finding Your Pet On Desktop", "Your pet lives on your desktop screen. Use the tray icon to show or hide it anytime.", "Got It"]
3: ["Select Your Experience", "Choose between an interactive story adventure or a persistent desktop companion."]
4: ["Secure Your Pet Companion", "Signing in ensures your pet data, traits, and accessories remain safe across launches.", "Sign In with Account"]
5: ["Talk to Your Companion", "Test sending a quick greeting to your pet right now.", "Say Hello...", "Send Message"]
6: ["Hatching Desktop Companion", "Finalizing pet animations and system tray integrations."]
7: ["Your Pet Story Begins", "Discover how your companion grows and interacts on your desktop workspace."]
8: ["Cloud Save Protection - Never Lose Your Pet"]
9: ["Unlocked: Day One Companion Founder Badge"]

verdicts.problem: Creates scarcity and urgency using a time-sensitive 'Day One' founder reward.
